simple.meaning: זַעֲוָן (Zaʻăvân) is a Hebrew word meaning “Zaavan , an Idumaean.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: זַעֲוָן (H2190) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Genesis 36:27, with occurrences in Genesis, 1 Chronicles.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to זַעֲוָן (H2190) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in זַעֲוָן (H2190) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: זַעֲוָן (Zaʻăvân) / H2190 is traced through Genesis 36:27, 1 Chronicles 1:42 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.full: H2190. Zaavan זַעֲוָן proper name, masculine a Horite Gen 36:27 = 1Chr 1:42 . זַעֲוָן proper name, masculine a descendant (branch or tribe) of Seir ( ᵐ5 Ζουκαμ , but Ζαυαν ᵐ5 L 1Chr 1:42 ; Samaritan זוען ) — Gen 36:27 = 1Chr 1:42 .
